changelog: Jellyfin 12.4 fork of Jellyscribe 2.15.0: built for Jellyfin 12.4/.NET 10; no automatic posting (play events, rating pushes, scheduled sync disabled); new LetterboxdLog API (Status/Entry/Entries) for explicitly confirmed diary entries with offline queue and update-instead-of-duplicate; no upstream repository injection. 2.15.0.125: no sidebar/user-menu entry; account API (GET/POST/DELETE LetterboxdLog/Account) for Cinema Glass; minimal admin page listing linked users and waiting entries. 2.15.0.126: GET LetterboxdLog/Ratings returns all films the linked member rated, liked or watched (official API, cached 6 h per user).
description: Syncs Jellyfin watch history to Letterboxd (fork of builtbyproxy/jellyfin-plugin-letterboxd, MIT).
name: Jellyscribe
overview: Letterboxd diary logging on request (Jellyfin 12.4 fork)
